description: TPO 351 T1 1x Sycamore  to cut back all lateral overhanging branches back to boundary by removing approx 3m.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The removal of deadwood, dangerous / hanging branches and ivy:  This does not require the formal consent of the Council.

Statutory crown lifting of trees: This does not require formal consent of the Council if the clearance only involves the removal of branches to give a separation between the footway and the tips of the lowest branches by up to 2.3m or the carriageway by up to 5.2m.

The early mature Sycamore tree is situated at the front of the property. It is in a fair condition and can be seen by neighbours and passers. For these reasons, it has a moderate to high amenity value.

Although the application is to enforce the common law right, the trees health and stability would be negatively affected by the extent of branch removal. By removing one side of the canopy, it will be unbalanced with an increased likelihood of failure.
The amount being removed in the specification is too intrusive to the health and stability of the tree.
